ctx.x: You see, because really, that's what jazz is. It's the rhythmic improvisation on any piece. You can take -- I know, years before that, I think I told you there was a fellow by the name of Duke, and he took "Onward Christian Soldiers". When they got through with it, swinging it with the stride, like he used to, like he used to play like that. And the improvisation is when you don't give a note all its beats, you see? You cut it short, like, (sings), you know what I mean?
